name: disclosure-schedules
description: Drafts and reviews M&A disclosure schedules and letters qualifying the reps, warranties and interim covenants in merger, stock purchase and asset purchase agreements. Maps every rep in the newest agreement draft to a correctly numbered schedule; checks lead-ins, list versus exception reps, thresholds, lookbacks and entity scope; drafts specific factual disclosures with express cross-references rather than a reasonably apparent clause; keeps knowledge and materiality qualifiers out of the schedules; strips admissions and privileged advice; and handles governmental consents and approvals schedules, SEC reports carve-outs and Item 601 omitted schedules. Classifies schedule supplements between signing and closing for closing conditions, indemnity and termination, and applies sandbagging defaults and reservation of rights. Use for disclosure schedules, schedule of exceptions, schedule supplements, or rep exceptions. Routes agreement changes to merger-agreement and diligence gaps to due-diligence-report.
